test_title: PYST 08: RRB NTPC Graduate Level CBT-I - GA (Held On: 09 Jun, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: In the ministerial hierarchy in India, Ministers of State generally have:

options.text: . no executive responsibility in any of the portfolios
secondary rank within the portfolios assigned to Cabinet Ministers
equal standing with Cabinet Ministers in their assigned portfolios

solution:
The Correct answer is __**secondary rank within the portfolios assigned to Cabinet Ministers**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In the **ministerial hierarchy** of India, the **Ministers of State** are junior ministers who work under the supervision of **Cabinet Ministers**.
 
• Their role is to assist in handling the **portfolios** that are assigned to the Cabinet Ministers.
